evidence.summary: Permutation feature importance identified recent_strikes as the top predictor (importance > 0.21). Accumulating moderation strikes strongly penalizes and lowers the target score.
User reputation rank emerged as the second highest feature driver (~0.09 permutation importance). High reputation scores consistently drive the predicted moderation score toward approval.
Account tenure in months contributes positively to target score, showing that account longevity acts as a positive signal in the GK-04 scoring model.
Having additional linked verified accounts provides a positive boost to target score stability and reduces false-decline risk.
